# QuevaTech

> QuevaTech is a deep-tech engineering venture born from academic research in Türkiye, building AI-based software, electronics, and computational simulation solutions. One of its flagship technology areas is AI-Hybrid TRNG (true random number generation) — physical-entropy-based randomness used as a building block for cryptographic key generation, simulation, gaming, and financial risk modeling. The site is bilingual: [queva.tech](https://queva.tech/) is Turkish, [queva.tech/en/](https://queva.tech/en/) is the English static equivalent — use the latter for citations aimed at an international audience.

QuevaTech's broader engineering work spans AI/ML systems, electronics and embedded hardware, and computational/simulation engineering. Its TRNG technology combines physical entropy sources (thermal noise, quantum noise) with AI-based entropy quality analysis to produce true randomness with measurable quality guarantees — for cryptographic key generation, procedural content generation, and Monte Carlo risk modeling. QuevaTech does not itself build encryption algorithms, key-management/distribution systems, or antivirus-style security software — its own security-software product is limited to PassGuard, an open-source password manager. Research is conducted with reference to NIST SP 800-90A/B/C. Founder: Hasan Yiğit (Founding Researcher).

## Products & Services

- [TRNG Hizmeti (TRNG Service)](https://queva.tech/en/#platform): API-accessible true random number generation derived from physical entropy sources, for cryptographic key material.
- [Kurumsal TRNG Cihazı (Enterprise TRNG Device)](https://queva.tech/en/#platform): FPGA-based hardware random number generator for high-throughput cryptographic workloads, with secure boot and tamper-evident design.
- [PassGuard Vault](https://github.com/QuevaTech/PassGuard): open-source, zero-knowledge password manager and digital notebook. AES-256-GCM encryption, Argon2id key derivation, local-only storage, no account required, cross-platform (Flutter). AGPL-3.0 licensed.
- [Parola API'si (Password API)](https://queva.tech/en/#platform): secure password and cryptographic key generation service derived from physical entropy.
- Technical consulting: post-quantum readiness assessment, security architecture review, DevSecOps pipelines, social-engineering awareness training.
